messages:
Iris: weekend thought: we should standardize service token claim keys. half our code uses project, others use project_id, some use tenant. it's a mess.
Jon: +1. propose canonical claims: 'proj' for project id, 'org' for org id, 'act' for actor id, 'scp' for scopes. short to keep token size small.
Hannah: ok but need a compatibility shim. tokens minted before change will have old keys. suggest authorizer accept old keys too for 90d and log mapping warnings.
Iris: agree. also enforce a naming guide in the broker and SDKs.\nJon: PSA: update go-auth lib to decode both forms and map to canonical. will send PR.
Hannah: also update docs and add a linters in repo to prevent new tokens using deprecated claim names.
ops-bot: alert: detected token with both 'project' and 'proj' claims at 2026-04-05T08:12:01Z.
Iris: perfect, we'll throttle issuance for that client until owner responds.
Jon: minor: ensure canonical claims appear in RBAC logs exactly as 'proj' vs human-readable project name. we'll translate in observability layer.
Hannah: done. I'll add backward compat window to RFC.
Iris: short RFC addendum: claim naming + SDK linting + 90d shim. open PR?
Jon: opening PR now.
